items.title: OpenAI hits a compute wall and pauses $200 Pro subscriptions

items.title: Pacing might be good business, not just good safety
items.summary: Business: Google DeepMind's AGI economics director Alex Imas argues closed frontier firms live on a roughly six-month capability window over open models — and racing to widen it increases the odds of an incident that brings regulation crippling the entire ecosystem, closed labs included. Pacing may dent margins short-term, but it's good for medium and long-run economics.
